background: Northern Trust Corporation is the holding company of a Chicago-based custodian and wealth manager, earning fees from asset servicing for institutions and from managing money for wealthy families and foundations.
synthesis: Northern Trust is rated A+ on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at A, all three on a stable outlook. Leverage of 8.5% is in the top quarter of US banks, but CET1 of 12.0% is just below the median and LCR of 107% is in the bottom quarter, which is the figure to watch. Since 31 Mar 2025 CET1 has fallen 0.9 points and leverage 0.6 points, with LCR broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). The news is uneventful, the newest item on 30 Sep 2026 a share-price move, with strong quarterly earnings reported before it.
